title: 果园土壤监测与自动灌溉（综合设计）
goal: 综合运用 ADC 串行读取、LCD 显示、按键设定与滞环控制，完成"柚子果园土壤监测与自动灌溉"综合设计任务，理解真实场景中的工程控制策略。
doc:
综合设计型实验（虚实结合）：本实验是《单片机原理及应用》的综合性设计性实验（大作业级）， 任务原型来自团队真实物联网终端项目——柚子果园土壤监测与自动灌溉。 场景由果园仿真引擎驱动（Hargreaves ET0 蒸发蒸腾量、单作物系数、三层土壤水分平衡，模型均为教材级方法）， 学生程序经真实 SDCC 编译后在指令级仿真内核上运行，通过 ADC0832 串行 A/D 读取土壤含水量， 用滞环双阈值控制灌溉阀门——工程上真实的控制策略。

实验任务

1. 按模板检查电路：土壤湿度传感器（CS/CLK/DI/DO → P2.0~P2.3）、LCD1602（数据 P0.0~P0.7，注意 8 只上拉）、 按键 KEY+/KEY-/KEYH+（P2.4~P2.6）、灌溉水泵（P3.5）、串口适配器（交叉接线）。

2. 编写并编译程序：循环读取土壤含水量并在 LCD 显示；含水量低于下限（默认 45%）开阀灌溉， 高于上限（默认 60%）关阀——必须用滞环，不能用单阈值（否则阀门临界频繁启停，损伤设备）。

3. 按键设定阈值（软件消抖），串口约每 0.5 秒上报运行状态。

4. 观察场景曲线：无灌溉时含水量持续下降（蒸腾），开阀后回升；记录用水量与能耗统计。

原理要点

  • ADC0832 串行协议：CS 拉低启动，首时钟上升沿（DI=1）开始转换并输出前导 0 位，之后每时钟上升沿输出 1 位（MSB 优先），共 8 位；CS 拉高结束。
  • 滞环控制：开阀阈值 45%、关阀阈值 60%，中间为不动作区——防止在临界点附近频繁启停。
  • P0 漏极开路：作数据总线必须外接上拉电阻（模板已接 8 只 10KΩ）。
  • 场景模型：ET0 = 0.0023·Ra·(Tmean+17.8)·√(Tmax−Tmin)（Hargreaves），ETc = Kc·ET0，θ(t+Δt) = θ + (P + I − ETc − D − R)/z。

常见错误（自动评判对照）

  • 单阈值控制 → 阀门频繁切换（应使用滞环双阈值）；
  • ADC 读取时序错（漏读前导 0、CLK 边沿方向错）→ 读数非 0 即 255；
  • 按键无消抖 → 一次按下多次响应；
  • P0 未接上拉 → 数据总线高电平拉不起来、LCD 显示乱码。
goalEn: Combine serial ADC reading, LCD display, key setting and hysteresis control to complete a pomelo-orchard soil monitoring & auto-irrigation design task, and understand engineering control strategies in a real scenario.
docEn:
Comprehensive design lab (virtual–physical): this is the comprehensive design project of the course. The task originates from the team's real IoT terminal project — soil monitoring and auto-irrigation for a pomelo orchard. The scene is driven by an orchard simulation engine (Hargreaves ET0 reference evapotranspiration, a single crop coefficient, three-layer soil water balance — all textbook-grade models). Student programs run on the instruction-level core after a real SDCC build, read soil moisture through the ADC0832 serial ADC, and drive the irrigation valve with dual-threshold hysteresis — a genuinely engineering control strategy.

Tasks

1. Check the circuit against the template: soil moisture sensor (CS/CLK/DI/DO → P2.0–P2.3), LCD1602 (data on P0.0–P0.7 — mind the 8 pull-ups), buttons KEY+/KEY−/KEYH+ (P2.4–P2.6), irrigation pump (P3.5), UART adapter (crossover wiring).

2. Write and build the program: read soil moisture in a loop and show it on the LCD; open the valve when moisture drops below the lower threshold (default 45%) and close it above the upper threshold (default 60%) — hysteresis is mandatory, a single threshold is not acceptable (otherwise the valve chatters near the boundary and wears out).

3. Set the thresholds with the buttons (software debouncing); report the running status over serial about every 0.5s.

4. Watch the scene curves: without irrigation the moisture keeps falling (transpiration) and rises again when the valve opens; record the water and energy statistics.

Key points

  • ADC0832 serial protocol: pull CS low to start; the first clock rising edge (DI=1) starts the conversion and emits a leading 0 bit; each subsequent rising edge outputs one bit (MSB first), 8 bits in total; pull CS high to end.
  • Hysteresis control: open at 45%, close at 60%, no action in between — prevents rapid on/off cycling near the threshold.
  • P0 is open-drain: as a data bus it requires external pull-ups (the template already has 8 × 10kΩ).
  • Scene model: ET0 = 0.0023·Ra·(Tmean+17.8)·√(Tmax−Tmin) (Hargreaves); ETc = Kc·ET0; θ(t+Δt) = θ + (P + I − ETc − D − R)/z.

Common mistakes (checked by the auto-grader)

  • Single-threshold control → the valve switches too often (use dual-threshold hysteresis);
  • Wrong ADC timing (missing the leading 0, wrong clock edge) → readings are stuck at 0 or 255;
  • No button debouncing → one press handled multiple times;
  • P0 without pull-ups → the data bus cannot go high and the LCD shows garbage.
